name: Young Carer Support Service
shortDescription: Free support for young carers through individual assistance, group activities and connections with other young people.
plainEnglishSummary: If you help care for someone in your family, this service may help you get support, meet other young carers and feel more confident at school.
availabilityNote: Support is generally available for up to 12 months and may be extended depending on individual circumstances.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm eligibility. Contact an official program partner to check whether this service is suitable for your circumstances.
